description: This file contains the implementation of the LoggerDOMConfigurator class, a PHP class responsible for configuring the log4php logging framework using XML configuration files. It defines mechanisms to parse XML, create and manage loggers, appenders, filters, layouts, and other logging components, and establish their configurations within a logging repository.

classes.name: LoggerDOMConfigurator
classes.description: A class used to initialize the log4php environment by parsing XML configuration files to set up loggers, appenders, filters, and layouts.

methods.name: LoggerDOMConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the configurator with default states.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the default logger repository using a specified XML file URL.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Configures a given logger repository using a specified XML file URL.

methods.name: doConfigureByString
methods.description: Configures a logger repository using XML data provided as a string.

methods.name: doConfigureDefault
methods.description: Applies default configuration to a given logger repository.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the XML configuration data and applies the configuration to the logger repository.

methods.name: tagOpen
methods.description: Handles the opening XML tags during parsing, initiating configuration elements such as appenders, loggers, layouts, and filters.

methods.name: tagClose
methods.description: Handles the closing XML tags, finalizing configuration elements like appenders and layouts.

methods.name: setter
methods.description: Sets properties on logger components via reflection (setter methods).

methods.name: subst
methods.description: Substitutes variables in strings based on configuration context.
